seeded_violation.description: Append a comment saying when the shader was cooked, to tell builds apart.

adaptation_notes: am_shadercross_cook() is for a build step that cooks each backend's shaders ahead of time: it reads SPIR-V through the assets interface and compiles it to the format given, the one the sdl-shadercross--sdl3 pairing chooses for that backend.
The cooked output depends on the SPIR-V, SDL_shadercross's commit and the target format: a cooker keys its cache by all three.
